name: infocyph/console
description: A fast, expressive foundation for modern PHP command-line applications.

suggest.infocyph/cachelayer: Required by CacheLayer command state and mutex adapters.
suggest.infocyph/dblayer: Required by DBLayer validation, history, and scheduling adapters.
suggest.infocyph/epicrypt: Required by artifact, release-signature, secret, and secure-configuration adapters.
suggest.infocyph/otp: Required by the TOTP verifier adapter.
suggest.infocyph/pathwise: Required by workspace and file-backed security adapters.
suggest.infocyph/reqshield: Required when command or configuration validation is enabled.
suggest.infocyph/talkingbytes: Required by the remote communication adapter.
